# METIS

> METIS (metisai.in) is an AI product studio and consultancy serving businesses in India. We design, build and ship custom AI - AI agents, voice and conversational agents, workflow automations, AI strategy and validation, and AI product engineering - and teach teams to run it. Contact: info@metisai.in.

METIS works across five capabilities: Enterprise AI, Agentic Systems (including voice and conversational agents), Workflow Automations, AI Strategy & Validation, and Product Engineering. The Notes section covers India-specific rules that affect AI products and AI calling: the DPDP Act and TRAI's TCCCPR number-series rules.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://metisai.in/): What METIS does, the five capabilities, how engagements start, and a short FAQ.
- [Services](https://metisai.in/services/): The five capabilities and the services under each.
- [Services in detail](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/): Every service METIS builds, listed per capability.
- [About](https://metisai.in/about/): Who METIS is and how we work.
- [Contact](https://metisai.in/contact/): Send a few lines about the problem; we scope the riskiest part first.

## Capabilities

- [Enterprise AI](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#enterprise-ai): Production applications with compliance and security designed in from day one.
- [Agentic Systems](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#agentic-systems): Autonomous agents that reason, decide and act across existing tools, including voice and conversational agents for scheduling, support and operations.
- [Workflow Automations](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#workflow-automations): End-to-end automation of manual, multi-step processes.
- [AI Strategy & Validation](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#ai-strategy-validation): Validate the riskiest idea first with a working proof of concept.
- [Product Engineering](https://metisai.in/services/detailed/#product-engineering): Native-quality apps and products with AI at the core, built end to end.

## Notes

- [Notes index](https://metisai.in/blog/): Practical writing on AI voice agents, India's DPDP and TCCCPR rules, and building AI in production.
- [Send Indian customer data to OpenAI or Claude?](https://metisai.in/blog/dpdp-sending-customer-data-to-ai-models/): India's DPDP framework permits cross-border transfer unless a country is restricted, and what that means for teams building AI products.
- [140 or 1600: which series must insurance calls use?](https://metisai.in/blog/trai-140-1600-series-insurance-calls/): TRAI's restriction on ordinary 10-digit numbers for commercial calling from 1 January 2026, and which series applies to renewals.
- [10 questions before buying an AI calling agent](https://metisai.in/blog/questions-before-buying-ai-calling-india/): The questions that separate an AI voice system that survives real customers from one that does not.
